summary: Attribute triggers in authenticator maps: Operation decides how lists of attribute values are evaluated (and: all must match, or: any), multi-attribute maps are only possible through the API (the UI removes them), Attribute names the source field, and Comparison can be contains, matches, ends with, in or equals.
